title: Bookkeeping agency — UK e-commerce monthly close
summary: Reconcile a client's books to the penny every month. Pulls the bank feed daily, chases missing receipts, closes the month, prepares VAT for your approval.

requires_connections.name: bank-feed
requires_connections.secret_hint: The API token for the bank feed. Stored encrypted; never sent to the agent.

requires_connections.name: books-email
requires_connections.why: Chase missing receipts and deliver the close report.
requires_connections.secret_hint: Your transactional email provider's server token.

requires_connections.name: xero
requires_connections.why: The client's accounting ledger — where the reconciled month actually gets posted.
requires_connections.secret_hint: One OAuth click. Composio holds the grant and refreshes it, so nothing to paste and nothing to rotate.

# Engagement terms

Edit this with your actual terms. Example:
- Monthly close delivered by the 7th working day.
- VAT returns prepared, never filed without founder approval.
- Receipts chased up to 3 times, then escalated to the founder.
